> rust-stark-zkvm — Custom ISA STARK zkVM with Winterfell proving backend,
>> HTTP API, and MCP tool integration for AI agents.
>
> Language: Rust
> Focus: zero-knowledge proofs, verifiable computation, STARK arithmetization
>
> Repo: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/rust-stark-zkvm
> Stack: Winterfell, Ed25519, HTTP API, MCP tools
>
> Claims:
> - Custom ISA with JZ/JNZ conditional branching and fixed register file
> - STARK AIR arithmetization with Winterfell framework
> - HTTP proving API (POST /v1/proofs, GET /v1/verify)
> - MCP bindings for AI agents to call prove() and verify()
> - CI proof gates that block merge on invalid proofs
> - Multi-backend design: production Winterfell + labeled mock-echo simulator
>
> Verify: AGENTS.md | .github/workflows/proof-gate.yml | crates/zkvm-host-server
>
> Status: Proof gates active. Mock-echo backend is SIMULATED.
> Limitations: Educational reference; production deployments need independent security review.
